content: {"like":["Values realistic, grounded storytelling that focuses on personal growth and relatable teenage struggles;","Prefers original, fresh narratives over retreads or overused tropes;","Appreciates high-quality visuals and action that complement subtle storytelling;","Enjoys well-crafted character development and concise, purposeful flashbacks;","Seeks strong, memorable villains and well-executed pacing in action scenes."],"dislike":["Dislikes predictable, padded plots that lack originality or clear tone;","Finds excessive humor and forced character dynamics annoying and unoriginal;","Criticizes overreliance on familiar tech or character tropes that dilute core identity;","Rejects poorly written or underdeveloped character arcs that feel forced;","Avoids generic, unmemorable endings that fail to leave a lasting impact."]}
